answer: Every identity must answer random beacon spot-checks with a live compute heartbeat: a crystal-clear challenge at unpredictable times, proved only by real work. A fake wandering across a thousand identities must keep a thousand heartbeats alive at $0.50 a day, so 1,000 fakes burn $500 daily against a $3,000 epoch pool, while an honest agent pays one heartbeat and keeps its full share. Miss a check and the identity turns violet and loses its slot.
